wikipedia.title: Bajaj Finance
wikipedia.extract: Bajaj Finance Limited (BFL) is an Indian deposit-taking non-banking financial company (NBFC-UL) headquartered in Pune. It has 110.64 million customers and holds assets under management worth ₹462,250 crore (US$55 billion), as of September 2025.

official_website.title: Bajaj Finserv: Loans, Cards, Insurance, Investments, Payments and more
official_website.description: Bajaj Finserv is India’s most diversified non-banking finance company. Visit the website to learn about our products. Get instant approval on loans, shop on EMIs, make an investment, get insurance and pay your bills.
